notes.title: New Languages Added!
notes.content:
Fellow Porcupinians,

sorry to all of you that were waiting for this update for so long now. But it's finally here: with today's update we added the official translations for

[list]
[b][*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/afa8571b9aa4cdcd15ea5e25cc716cc9b37dc604.png[/img]


It's time for you to join Finley and his friends on this unique story adventure today - and enjoy it in your preferred language! 🍂 🚑

And thank you for your ongoing support, Fall of Porcupine was, still is, and will forever be a project of the heart.

Take care everyone,
Your teams @ Critical Rabbti and Assemble Entertainment

notes.title: Fall of Porcupine | Patch #8 | 1.1.13
notes.content:
Dear Porcupine-Fans,
we have released another Patch for Fall of Porcupine on Steam, in which we fixed some issues and bringing some adjustments. 

Find a detailed list below:
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed Maggys comic bug on some paths
[*] Fixed Mia bubble scale on end of day 6
[*] Fixed negative medication minigame values
[*] Fixed some layering issues
[*] Fixed snowball fight soft lock
[*] Fixed snow layer issue
[*] Fixed wrong card game tutorial text[/list]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list][*] Added MP cost display to fight abilities[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list][*] Potential scene change soft lock fix
[*] Updated day two events
[*] Updated the localisation files[/list]


Please keep reporting any issues or providing us feedback!
Thank you for your ongoing support! Please keep it up!
